title: Uncertainty deserves a number
summary: Uncertainty means we do not know the outcome for sure. A past fraction can describe observed results, but a small sample gives weak evidence about the future.
introduction: Uncertainty means we do not know the outcome for sure. A past fraction can describe observed results, but a small sample gives weak evidence about the future. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Uncertainty means we do not know the outcome for sure. A past fraction can describe observed results, but a small sample gives weak evidence about the future.
The output is 0.3. Three out of ten observed days were rainy. This alone is not a weather forecast for tomorrow.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain how observations from one season may miss another season.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not turn a small observed fraction into a guaranteed future chance.
For more detail later, use this [Artificial Intelligence further reading](https://ai4k12.org/resources/).
